exposure: Earlier nutrient supplementation (80 mL/kg/day total fluid intake, F80)
Later nutrient supplementation (160 mL/kg/day total fluid intake, F160)
outcome: Maximum weight loss as % birth weight
Decrease in weight Z-score at 10 days
cohort: The study participants were low-birthweight premature infants fed breast milk.
finding: Earlier nutrient supplementation in low-birthweight premature infants was associated with improved jaundice outcomes, reduced feeding intolerance, shorter length of stay, and earlier regain of birthweight.
followup_time: Around 19 days (based on length of stay and weight Z-score at 10 days)
